skill.summary: Get downloadable MP4 videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompt (TXT, DOCX, PDF, plain text, up to 500MB), say something...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Text to Video Download skill.
- Upload your text or document (TXT, DOCX, PDF, up to 500MB) and convert it to a downloadable 1080p MP4 video in minutes.
- Automatic backend setup: handles anonymous token and session creation for new users.
- Supports fast editing, batch processing, and export with simple chat prompts.
- Full credit and error handling included, with clear user messaging for all states.
